description_en: Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) Integration with Cloud Products
kebab_example: aliyun ga associate-resources --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --associated-resource-type WAF --associated-resource-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateResources

parameters.help_en: Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance ID.
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: Resource type of the linked instance.
parameters.name: associated_resource_type

parameters.help_en: Resource ID of the linked instance.
parameters.name: associated_resource_id

parameters.help_en:
Association pattern:  
Managed: Managed mode. GA restricts user operations based on management policies. Currently, no resources use this type.  
Associated (default): Loose coupling association. GA does not restrict user operations. WAF uses loose coupling.
parameters.help_zh:
关联模式：
Managed：托管，GA侧根据托管策略限制用户操作。目前无此类型资源。
Associated（默认）：松耦合关联，GA侧不会限制用户操作，WAF属于松耦合
parameters.name: associated_mode

parameters.help_en: Region ID of the basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Valid value: cn-hangzhou only.
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to perform a dry run of the request. Valid values:  
true: Sends a dry run request without associating resources. Checks include required parameters, request format, and business restrictions. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned.  
false (Default Value): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the endpoint group is created immediately.
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会进行资源关联。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回HTTP 2xx状态码。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接创建终端节点组
parameters.name: dry_run

AcceleratorId.description_en: Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance ID.
